programmes.d: When a potion brings Nazboo's squeaky chicken to life, Zeta tries to use the tricky toy to help her take over Zahramay Falls. Shimmer, Shine, and Leah must help Adara when Zeta uses a potion to control the Princess's bracelets from afar.

Nazboo goes off to help a genie with his deliveries, but Zeta worries she's lost him and enlists the girls' help to find him. When the girls learn to cloud surf, Shine gets overexcited and tries to ride the biggest wave at Cloud Beach.

Shimmer, Shine and Leah go to a new place called Zahramay Oceanea to help train a young genie-in-training named Arabella. But when Zeta shows up and tries to take over Oceanea, it's up to the girls and their new friend to stop her.
Zeta goes toe-to-toe with a powerful Sea Enchantress named Uzma. When Arabella flubs a wish grant, the girls must quickly fix her mistake or else the Dance of the Jellyfish will be ruined.

Zeta's upset when Nazboo abandons her on their special day, unaware that it's because he's planning a surprise party for her! When Nazboo loses one of his baby teeth, Zeta schemes to get a powerful present out of it from the Tooth Flitter.

The girls help the Zeashell Genie make surprisefilled zeashells, but sneaky Uzma swaps the surprises inside with her own. The girls run into trouble when Zeta enlists a cute magic-sucking fish to suck up their wish magic.

Zeta wreaks havoc when she enchants her sister's new zadazzling wand in an attempt to take over Zahramay Falls. When Zac opens a hotdog stand in Zahramay Falls, Zeta tries using the hotdogs to make her most powerful potion yet.

When the magical ladybugs escape from Samira's palace, the girls must get them back before Zeta cause trouble with them. When Zeta loses faith in her sorcery abilities, Shimmer, Shine and Leah help her search for something else she'd be good at.

When Uzma takes the magic jewel that powers Zeacorn Cove, the girls and their new Zeacorns friends set out to retrieve it. The girls and Arabella discover new magic in a secret cave, but trouble arises when Zeta takes the magic for herself.

When Zeta and Nazboo get zkunked by a smelly Zahramay zkunk, Shimmer, Shine and Leah try to help them get un-stinky. Zeta teams up with Shimmer, Shine, Leah and Princess Samira to stop Uzma from taking all the magic from Zahramay Falls.
Nella and her friends get lost in Minatori's maze. Miscommunication between Nella and Garrett causes their invention at the Royal Science Expo to go wrong.
After Trinket's horn is bent in an accident, Nella helps her find a wise unicorn to fix it. Nella and Trinket go on a quest to retrieve Trinket's childhood toy when she accidentally gives it away.
When the wicked wizard steals Garrett's knightly trading cards before the big trading convention, Nella is determined to get them back. Nella and Trinket compete to make the best ice-cream.
Nella and the gang must avoid getting their clothes dirty before a fancy party, but it proves harder than it sounds. Nella accompanies Snowpuff the dragon on a quest to find a legendary wishing well.

Nella and her friends are invited to a party in the mysterious kingdom of Sparkleburg but no one knows where it is! When Blaine finds himself in peril on a class climbing trip, it's up to Nella to help him!
When bad weather ruins their plans, Nella and her friends go on a quest inside the castle. During a cute critter watching trip, Olivia causes big problems by feeding a Chompling lunch.
When Badalf the wicked wizard takes Nella and Olivia's musical instruments they have to work together to get them back! Clod moves in with Trinket whilst his stable undergoes roof repairs.
When Trinket is mysteriously "frozen" at the Castlehaven Carnival, everyone blames Badalf.Nella embarks on an adventure to find rare ingredients for Trinket's special nail polish.

Nella goes on a quest for Bling Berries in the Murkberry Mines, so she can make her mom's favorite pancakes for breakfast! Nella and Blaine must find three baby dragons when they go missing from a play-date.
When Nella's sword gets an amazing upgrade she finds it difficult to master its new power. It's the Castlehaven Jousting Tournament and all the gang want to win!
Nella and her friends take part in an action-packed go-kart race! Nella and Blaine search for the mysterious Moat Lake Monster.
After a display of true courage, Trinket receives a sparkling new carriage from the Unicorn of the Lake. Nella and Cici combine their talents to form The Castlehaven Rescue Club.
Nella and her friends discover a kingdom in the clouds. When Trinket and Olivia are turned into icky lizards, Nella and her friends must find the antidote.
Nella, Garrett, and Blaine compete for an annual bravery award, with chaotic consequences. Badalf the Wicked Wizard steals a magical saber that can turn things into sand.
When a young Princess Nella meets a lost unicorn, she finds the courage to make her dreams come true by becoming a Princess Knight.

Nella and her grandparents work together when she accidently plants a Dandydragon; a flower that acts just like a real dragon!/When Munchie the dragon is hungry for knowledge, she eats Garrett's homework. Nella and friends must get it back before school.

When the Wicked Wizard's pet goat becomes a goatzilla, Nella and the gang must save the big day./Nella and Trinket are invited to a Minotaur tea-party, but Trinket has a tough time taking part in the festivities.

When Bogner the Bog-Troll takes Nella's bounce-house as her new home, she accidently takes Clod too - who is still bouncing inside!/Castlehaven begins to sink when the Diggykins build their underground kingdom beneath Nella's village garden.

Blaine gets less than he bargained for when he scouts for his very own steed with Nella./When Trinket loses her voice before a special duet, she and Nella must journey to the Shimmering Steamspring for a cure.

Nella and her Dad square off with a fearsome gladiator after he slips away with King Dad's crown!/Nella and the gang journey to a carriage showcase, but Clod worries that Garret's new go-kart will steal his thunder, and his best friend.
Nella is sent on a hair-raising rescue when Trinket is pressured into copying her friends./Blaine serves Nella a culinary catastrophe when he tries to hide his passion for cooking.

When Olivia's sparkly ball is lost in the bowling lanes, Nella and friends venture into a bowling wonderland beyond the pins to get it back./While Nella and the gang prepare for Garrett's dad's wedding, Tricksy swaps the ring for something silly.
When Nella invites Gork's cousin to their Mud Day celebration, Gork does everything he can to impress him./When Nella and Trinket want to do different things, they begin to question their friendship.

Nella and her friends are sent on a mysterious quest by Nella's Aunt Whinnie to unlock a knightly surprise./When Nella and her friends all get new knightly tools, Blaine is worried that his isn't as good as the others.

Nella meets her match at Castlehaven's Friendship Games, when a new friend becomes determined to win at any cost./When Nella's clubhouse tree loses its luster, Nella and her friends must get to the root of the problem.
Nella must save Castlehaven from a surprise blizzard before it freezes her entire kingdom./When Nella's music idol comes to town to give a concert, there aren't enough tickets for everyone.
When the Tooth Fairy doesn't arrive in Castlehaven, Nella investigates her mysterious disappearance./With his arm in a cast, Garrett must find a new way to be a hero on an urgent knightly quest.

Nella and Trinket's perfect tea party goes wrong when they accidentally use boingy-berries in their muffins./When Nella and Riley are asked to rock-sit, they don't realize the importance of their mission.

When Nella invites a group of lost Chomplings to a knightly sleepover, Blaine thinks they're cramping his style... until he realizes they've lost their home./Nella must rescue Blaine when his tall-tales get him in big trouble.
Riley secretly enlists the help of a music loving dragon to play a duet with Nella at a big recital./Dwayne is nervous about going on his first quest as Blaine's steed.
Nella helps Cici learn how to stand up and stand out when Tricksy tries to steal a sparkly trophy./Worried that he won't fit in, a giant ogre shrinks himself using a magical wishing wagon.

Nella journeys to Riley's kingdom in search of a special glowfruit for King Dad's surprise birthday cake./When Gork dresses as Nella for a costume party, a tricky villain mistakes him for the real princess knight.

Nella helps her family get to an important sports tournament, and proves she's ready for big things along the way./Nella invites Riley on a tour of Castlehaven, but Riley becomes more interested in winning a photo contest instead.

When Castlehaven loses its sparkle, Nella and the Knights of the Sparkly Table face their toughest challenge ever./Nella's family vacation to Lake Twinkle is jeopardized when a tricky villain makes off with the source of its twinkle.
The Fresh Beats are out of school and they want to do something fun.
When the Fresh Beats bring a plant indoors and start singing scat to it, the plant grows and takes over the lobby.
A pink balloon wants to play with the Fresh Beats.
The Fresh Beats decide to order a new car online. However, when it's delivered, it comes in 57 boxes and they can't figure out how to put it together.
It's summer and the Fresh Beats are going camping and hoping to spot a shooting star.
When the circus only half-arrives, the Fresh Beats jump in to help save it for the Junior Beats.
When it starts raining, Twist, Shout and Kiki run for cover. But the rhythm-of-the-rain sound inspires Marina to write a new song.
The Fresh Beats want to do a basketball dance but Shout can't do his super-fast move right. So they build presto pants to help them.

It's their first day back at music school and the Fresh Beats reminisce about their favorite songs. They can't decide on just one song, so they decide to make a brand new, awesome back-to-school song.

Kiki's favorite violin duo, Nuttin' But Stringz, invites the Fresh Beats to perform with them. But when Kiki's favorite violin is missing, the Fresh Beats follow the clues to solve the mystery of her missing violin.
The Fresh Beats are graduating from Music School! Everyone dreams of doing new things after graduation, but what does Marina want to do? And does this mean the end of the band?
